```{r roi level}

calculate_mean_knn_roi <- function(attn_cell, cell_type1, cell_type2, attn = 2) {

  if (cell_type1 == "Immune" || cell_type2 == "Immune") {
    attn_cell <- attn_cell %>%
      mutate(Class = case_when(
        Class %in% c("Lymphocyte", "Plasma", "OtherImmune") ~ "Immune",
        TRUE ~ Class
      ))
  }

  if (cell_type1 == "Lymph.Plasma" || cell_type2 == "Lymph.Plasma") {
    attn_cell <- attn_cell %>%
      mutate(Class = case_when(
        Class %in% c("Lymphocyte", "Plasma") ~ "Lymph.Plasma",
        TRUE ~ Class
      ))
  }

  # Filter based on attention score if needed
  attn_cell_filtered <- attn_cell %>%
    {if (attn == 1) filter(., !(Class == cell_type1 & attention_score < 0.5))
     else if (attn == 0) filter(., !(Class == cell_type1 & attention_score >= 0.5))
     else .}

  # Group by Image and calculate kNN distances
  knn_result <- attn_cell_filtered %>%
    group_by(Image) %>%
    group_map(~ {
      # Filter coordinates for cell_type1 and cell_type2
      coords_class1 <- .x %>%
        filter(Class == cell_type1) %>%
        select(Centroid.X.µm, Centroid.Y.µm) %>%
        mutate(
          Centroid.X.µm = as.numeric(Centroid.X.µm),
          Centroid.Y.µm = as.numeric(Centroid.Y.µm)
        ) %>%
        as.matrix()

      coords_class2 <- .x %>%
        filter(Class == cell_type2) %>%
        select(Centroid.X.µm, Centroid.Y.µm) %>%
        mutate(
          Centroid.X.µm = as.numeric(Centroid.X.µm),
          Centroid.Y.µm = as.numeric(Centroid.Y.µm)
        ) %>%
        as.matrix()

      # Check if both classes have points; if not, skip
      min_length <- min(nrow(coords_class1), nrow(coords_class2))
      if (min_length == 0) {
        return(tibble(
          Image = first(.x$Image),
          mean_knn = NA,
          sd_knn = NA,
          min_knn = NA,
          max_knn = NA,
          cv_knn = NA
        ))
      }else{

      # Check if there is enough values
      k <- ifelse(min_length < 10, min_length - 1, 10)

      # mean_knn_12 <- mean(get.knnx(coords_class1, coords_class2, k = k)$nn.dist)
      tryCatch({
        knn_distances <- get.knnx(coords_class1, coords_class2, k = k)$nn.dist
      }, error = function(e) {
          cat("Error message:", e$message, "\n")
          return(
                tibble(
                  Image = first(.x$Image),
                  mean_knn = NA,
                  sd_knn = NA,
                  min_knn = NA,
                  max_knn = NA,
                  cv_knn = NA
                ))})
      mean_val <- mean(knn_distances, na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_val <- sd(knn_distances, na.rm = TRUE)


      return(tibble(
        Image = first(.x$Image),
        mean_knn = mean_val,
        sd_knn = sd_val,
        min_knn = min(knn_distances, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_knn = max(knn_distances, na.rm = TRUE),
        cv_knn = ifelse(mean_val > 0, sd_val/mean_val, NA)) #Tissue organization heterogeneity (uniform vs clustered)
      )}
    }, .keep = TRUE) %>%
    bind_rows()
  
  return(knn_result)
}

# Function to get kNN results using parallel processing
get_knn_results <- function(attn_cell) {
  attn_groups <- c(0, 1, 2)
  all_results <- list()
  
  for (attn in attn_groups) {
    # Filter data based on attention score
    if (attn == 0) {
      filtered_data <- attn_cell %>% filter(attention_score < 0.5)
    } else if (attn == 1) {
      filtered_data <- attn_cell %>% filter(attention_score >= 0.5)
    } else {
      filtered_data <- attn_cell
    }
    
    # Epithelial vs Stroma
    epi_stroma_result <- calculate_mean_knn_roi(filtered_data, "Epithelial", "Stroma", attn)
    # Add proper column names with attention group suffix
    colnames(epi_stroma_result)[-1] <- paste0("Epithelial_Stroma_", colnames(epi_stroma_result)[-1], "_attn", attn)
    all_results[[paste0("Epithelial_Stroma_attn", attn)]] <- epi_stroma_result
    
    # Epithelial vs Immune cell classes
    immune_classes <- c("Immune", "Lymph.Plasma", "Lymphocyte", "Plasma")
    
    for (immune_class in immune_classes) {
      # Epithelial vs Immune
      epi_immune_result <- calculate_mean_knn_roi(filtered_data, "Epithelial", immune_class, attn)
      colnames(epi_immune_result)[-1] <- paste0("Epithelial_", immune_class, "_", colnames(epi_immune_result)[-1], "_attn", attn)
      all_results[[paste0("Epithelial_", immune_class, "_attn", attn)]] <- epi_immune_result
      
      # Immune vs Stroma
      immune_stroma_result <- calculate_mean_knn_roi(filtered_data, immune_class, "Stroma", attn)
      colnames(immune_stroma_result)[-1] <- paste0(immune_class, "_Stroma_", colnames(immune_stroma_result)[-1], "_attn", attn)
      all_results[[paste0(immune_class, "_Stroma_attn", attn)]] <- immune_stroma_result
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all results by Image first, then aggregate by wsi
  combined_results <- all_results %>%
  keep(~ nrow(.x) > 0) %>%  # Remove empty dataframes
  reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "Image"))
  
  # Add wsi column and aggregate
  results_df <- combined_results %>%
    mutate(wsi = substr(Image, 1, 5)) %>%
    select(-Image) %>%
    group_by(wsi) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
  
  return(results_df)
}



```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

summary_knn <- attn_cell%>%
  get_knn_results()
```

```{r plot}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
export_folder = file.path(BE_MASTER, "3.integration/integration_project/spatial_analysis/tabular/calculated/")
mean_knn <- read.csv(file = paste0(export_folder,"mean_knn.csv"))
```

```{r}
analyse_columns <- names(mean_knn)[grepl("^meanKNN_", names(mean_knn))]

plots_folder = file.path(BE_MASTER, "3.integration/integration_project/spatial_analysis/plot/knn/")
dir.create(file.path(plots_folder,"progression","intraWsi"), recursive = T)
dir.create(file.path(plots_folder,"pred"))

```


```{r progression_plot}
for (pred_condition in c(0,1,"all")) {
  for (col in analyse_columns) {
    plot <- mean_knn%>%
      { if (pred_condition != "all") filter(., pred == pred_condition) else . }%>%
      drop_na(progression, !!sym(col))%>%
      ggboxplot(x = "progression", y = col, fill = "progression") +
      stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", paired = FALSE) +
      labs(title = paste("knn ", col))
  
    # Save the plot to the plots folder
    ggsave(filename = file.path(plots_folder,"progression",paste0("meanKNN_pred",pred_condition, "_",col, ".pdf")), plot = plot, width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}


# progression
mean_knn_long <- mean_knn %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = analyse_columns)


unique_col_names <- unique(substring(analyse_columns, 1, nchar(analyse_columns) - 1))
p_values_list <- list()

calculate_p_values <- function(data, group_col, value_col) {
  p_values <- data %>%
    group_by(!!sym(group_col)) %>%
    summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(!!sym(value_col) ~ name)$p.value)
  return(p_values)
}


for (progress_condition in c(0, 1)) {
  for (unique_col_name in unique_col_names) {
    filtered_data <- mean_knn_long %>%
      filter(name == paste0(unique_col_name, "0") | name == paste0(unique_col_name, "1"))%>%
      { if (pred_condition != "all") filter(., pred == pred_condition) else . } %>%
      # filter(pred == 1) %>%
      drop_na(progression)%>%
      mutate(across(all_of(c("progression", "name")), factor))%>%
      arrange(wsi)

      # comparisons <- combn(unique(levels(filtered_data$progression)), 2, simplify = FALSE)
      p_values <- calculate_p_values(filtered_data, "progression", "value")



      # plot <- ggboxplot(filtered_data, 
      #             x = "progression", 
      #             y = "value", 
      #             fill = "name") + 
      #   stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", 
      #                      paired = FALSE,
      #                      comparisons = unique_col_names) +
      #   labs(title = paste("Density for", unique_col_name, "with pred condition", pred_condition))
      
      p  <- ggboxplot(filtered_data,
                   x = "progression",
                   y = "value",
                   fill = "name") +
      labs(title = paste("Ripley for", unique_col_name, "with pred condition", pred_condition)) +
      stat_compare_means(aes(group = name), label = "p.signif", method = "wilcox.test")

      # Save the plot to the plots folder
      ggsave(filename = file.path(plots_folder,"progression", "intraWsi",paste0("meanKNN_pred", pred_condition, "_", unique_col_name, ".pdf")), 
             plot = p, width = 8, height = 6)

  }
  }
```
